Q1.rationale: The NDA does not mention verbally conveyed information; the definition refers only to confidential, proprietary and trade secret information.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: The NDA contains no duty to notify the Disclosing Party when disclosure is required by law; it only acknowledges Freedom of Information disclosure obligations.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segment 18 states the Receiving Party shall not use Confidential Information for any purpose other than those stated in the agreement.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 30 states the Receiving Party shall destroy or return some Confidential Information upon termination.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Segment 21 requires the Receiving Party to protect Confidential Information with reasonable administrative, physical and technical safeguards.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: The NDA contains no duty to promptly notify the Disclosing Party of unauthorized use or disclosure.
Q8.label: NotMentioned

Q9.rationale: Segment 19 states the Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of its employees.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Segment 22 permits disclosure to external auditors and service providers; consultants and agents are not expressly named as permitted recipients.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segment 1 states some obligations of the agreement may survive termination.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Remedies are injunctive and other equitable relief; no liquidated damages or contractual penalty is provided.
Q14.label: NotMentioned

Q15.rationale: Segment 26 states the Receiving Party may develop similar products or services whether or not the development uses ideas learned from the Disclosing Party.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 0 states the agreement shall not grant the Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 29 states the Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that the agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q17.label: Entailment

Q18.rationale: The NDA does not address reporting possible violations of law to government agencies; it only acknowledges Freedom of Information disclosure obligations.
Q18.label: NotMentioned
